summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Founders 100 ETF (FFF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund invests in 100 founder-led companies believed to be capable of generating superior expected risk-adjusted returns. The actively managed ETF does not limit its investments by country or market cap. FFF was launched on Dec 18, 2025 and is issued by Founder.

holdings.infoBox: FFF is an equity ETF with a total of 102 individual holdings. The top holdings are Meta Platforms stock at 9.25%, NVIDIA at 7.43%, Palantir Technologies at 7.07%, Oracle at 6.27%, and Dell Technologies at 6.03%.
